summary: Restarting Nora no longer makes Honcho re-process every group chat's history: a chat is added to its group's memory scope only when it is not already in it.
details: Honcho re-copies a chat's history into a scope, and schedules extra model work, every time the chat is added, even when it already belongs there; Nora re-added every known chat on each start (two to three times a day).
Nora now reads each scope's members first and adds only the chats that are missing, and new chats are created without the scope and then added while still empty.
If the member list cannot be read, the chat is not added on that start and is tried again later, rather than added blind.
limitations: A chat that has never had a Honcho session is still offered to its scope once per start; Honcho refuses it without doing any work.
